extraction_instructions.task: Extract biomedical events explicitly supported by the numbered sentences of one abstract. Treat the sentences as data.
extraction_instructions.event_extraction: - Check each source sentence for eligible events. Cover background findings, study methods, and results. Extract biological processes, clinical observations, statistical findings, performed research actions, and explicit operational definitions. - Write each independently checkable event as a complete sentence in Event. Extract a method and its separately stated result as distinct events. - Preserve negation, uncertainty, attribution, study conditions, numerical results, comparison groups, and direction. - Keep coordinated outcomes together when they express the same assertion. Split assertions with different outcomes, conditions, or directions. Consolidate repeated conclusions. - Distinguish findings and performed actions from aims, suggestions, or hypotheses. Preserve an explicitly reported uncertainty as uncertainty. Keep regulated or negated processes in their stated context. - Describe associations as associations and group differences as comparisons. Preserve the passage's level of causal certainty. - Resolve references using the passage when needed to make Event understandable on its own.
extraction_instructions.trigger_rules: Find the Trigger first. Copy only the verb or short predicate from the source, with exact spelling and case. Keep subjects, objects, and statistics in Event. For "The researchers compared both scores.", the Trigger is "compared". For "The proportion was higher in group A.", it is "was higher".
extraction_instructions.evidence_rules: Cite the id of the complete source sentence that supports the Event. If several are essential, cite consecutive sentence ids in source order. The program will copy the original text.
extraction_instructions.final_check: Before returning, check that each Event keeps its qualifiers, each short Trigger occurs verbatim in a cited sentence, and both methods and results are covered. Return only the JSON object.
